title: Banshee Ascent
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A roaring white-noise riser that screams from a low sub-rumble into a full-spectrum shriek across a 32-cycle filter journey. Resonance climbs, the band-pass sweep tears upward, and a phaser plus reversed echoes give it a clawing, banshee character before it resets.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  s("white*4")
    .lpf(saw.slow(32).range(180, 9000)).resonance(sine.slow(16).range(8, 22)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(24).range(2, 8)).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.18)
    .bpf(sine.slow(13).range(400, 6000)).bpq(sine.slow(7).range(3, 12))
    .shape(sine.slow(11).range(0.2, 0.55)).crush("<16 12 8 6>/8")
    .phaser(sine.slow(9).range(0.2, 2)).phaserdepth(0.8)
    .pan(sine.slow(5).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .attack(0.02).decay(0.25).sustain(0.6).release(0.08)
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(0.125, x => x.hpf(2000).gain(0.3).pan(0.2))
    .room(0.35).gain(0.9)
)
